narr: Several rounds of severe thunderstorms produced large hail, damaging wind gusts, and tornadoes through the day on April 17th.
ev: Several homes along Mohr Road were threatened by floodwaters from a nearby creek.
Water flooded several roads in the Belhaven area to a depth of at least 6 inches, and at least one vehicle was damaged attempting to cross a flooded intersection.
A portion of Choctaw Road was flooded.
The intersection area of MS Highway 42 and MS Highway 13 was flooded.
US Highway 49 at the 4th Street overpass was closed due to flooding, and the intersection of 7th St. and 25th St. was closed due to flooding.
The frontage road south of Interstate 20 near Pearson Road was flooded with at least a foot of standing water. A car stalled in the floodwater.
